title: Functional architecture of the human insula
abstract: The insular cortex has a central role in pain1,2, interoception3,4 and feelings5,6, yet its functional architecture and causal electrophysiological relationships among its subregions remain poorly understood. Here we combine intracranial electrical stimulation and task-based electroencephalography recordings with connectivity mapping within a cytoarchitectonic atlas of the human insula7–10 in 87 participants implanted with intracranial electrodes, and identify a quadripartite functional architecture comprising four distinct regions: (1) a dorsal–posterior region encoding somatotopically organized nociceptive/thermoceptive and somatosensory signals; (2) a ventral–posterior region with access to somatic information across multiple body parts; (3) a mid-anterior region associated with visceral sensations and anxiety states; and (4) an anterior–polar region, largely silent to direct stimulation, yet showing robust activation during salience detection and change of action mode. Critically, this anterior region, with its strong connections with the prefrontal cortex, including the anterior cingulate cortex, exerts strong and direct influence over other insular regions, while receiving less-strong indirect inputs from them, revealing an electrophysiological pathway for cognitive modulation of pain and bodily perception. Together, these findings define a functional architecture of the human insula that links cytoarchitecture to directed and asymmetric electrophysiological interactions, with mechanistic implications for cognitive modulation of pain and interoceptive experience. A functional architecture of the human insula links cytoarchitecture to directed and asymmetric electrophysiological interactions, with mechanistic implications for cognitive modulation of pain and interoceptive experience.
abstract_zh: 岛叶皮层在疼痛1,2、内感受3,4和情感5,6中起核心作用，然而其功能架构及其亚区之间的因果电生理关系仍不甚清楚。本研究将颅内电刺激与基于任务的脑电图记录相结合，并结合对87名植入颅内电极受试者的人类岛叶细胞结构图谱7–10进行连接图谱分析，鉴定出一种四分体功能架构，包含四个不同区域：（1）背部-后部区域，编码体位组织的伤害性/热感和体感信号；（2）腹部-后部区域，可获取多个身体部位的躯体信息；（3）中前部区域，与内脏感觉和焦虑状态相关；以及（4）前极区域，对直接刺激基本无反应，但在显著性检测和行动模式转换期间表现出强烈激活。关键的是，该前区与前额叶皮层（包括前扣带回皮层）具有强连接，对其他岛叶区域施加强且直接的影响，同时从其他区域接收较弱的间接输入，揭示了一条电生理通路，用于调节疼痛和身体感知的认知调控。这些发现共同界定了人类岛叶的功能架构，将细胞结构与有方向且不对称的电生理相互作用联系起来，对于疼痛和内感受体验的认知调控具有机制学意义。人类岛叶的功能架构将细胞结构与有方向且不对称的电生理相互作用联系起来，对于疼痛和内感受体验的认知调控具有机制学意义。
